description: One answer to "where can I buy IMPOSSIBREW?". Give a UK town or postcode (optional) and it returns the best buying options in order: direct from impossibrew.co.uk, Zapp rapid delivery in London (also Zapp on Deliveroo and Uber Eats), Ocado, Amazon, and verified pubs, shops and venues nearby with distances. Only the outward part of a postcode is looked up. Retailer stock and prices are not checked live.
